A small scheduled workflow can recover hours every month.

1. Run every weekday
2. Find overdue invoices
3. Choose reminder stage
4. Log the message sent

Consistent reminders, a clean audit trail, and less awkward admin.

items.voiceScript: Here is a boring automation that can save real money. Every weekday, find overdue invoices, check payment status one last time, choose the correct reminder stage, then log the message. No autonomous agent needed. The important parts are the final payment check and the sent log. Build boring systems before impressive ones. Save this, and grab my free n eight n templates from the bio.
